title: Adoption of Internet of Things in Health Care: Weighted and Meta-Analytical Review of Theoretical Frameworks and Predictors
core_idea: Perform a comprehensive quantitative review combining weight analysis and random-effects meta-analysis of peer-reviewed studies to identify influential predictors and theoretical frameworks that explain adoption of IoT technologies in health care, using systematic database searches, clear inclusion/exclusion criteria, and assessments of bias and heterogeneity.
tldr: A methods-focused meta- and weight-analysis aiming to map which theoretical frameworks and predictors have been used to explain IoT adoption in health care, based on a systematic synthesis of quantitative studies (no results included).
